title.h1: Modular, prefabricated data centers enter the AI era and boldly go where no data centers have gone before

meta_description.text: Modular data centers may not be new, but challenges driven by the latest accelerated compute AI clusters are forcing accelerated change in the way data centers are designed and deployed. While prefabrication could have been seen as a luxury a couple of decades ago, at this scale of deployment and with these challenging densities coupled with a major shortage of tradespeople, prefabrication is a necessity today.
